include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include)
add_subdirectory(include)
add_subdirectory(lib)
if(TRITON_BUILD_PYTHON_MODULE AND TRITON_BUILD_PROTON)
  set(TRITON_PROTON_LINK_LIBS ProtonToProtonGPU ProtonGPUToLLVM ProtonAnalysis)
  if("nvidia" IN_LIST TRITON_CODEGEN_BACKENDS)
    list(APPEND TRITON_PROTON_LINK_LIBS ProtonNVIDIAGPUToLLVM)
  endif()
  if("amd" IN_LIST TRITON_CODEGEN_BACKENDS)
    list(APPEND TRITON_PROTON_LINK_LIBS ProtonAMDGPUToLLVM)
  endif()
  add_triton_plugin(TritonProton ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/triton_proton.cc LINK_LIBS ${TRITON_PROTON_LINK_LIBS})
  target_link_libraries(TritonProton PRIVATE Python3::Module pybind11::headers)
endif()
